text: # FDA Precision Oncology Product Labeling & Dosage Specifications ## Category: Treatment & Safety Bulletins ### 1. Docetaxel (Taxotere) - **Indication**: Locally advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer, breast cancer, prostate cancer. - **Standard Dosing**: 60 mg/m2 to 100 mg/m2 IV over 1 hour every 3 weeks. Typical flat-dose equivalents observed in project cohorts: 140 mg to 300 mg. - **Black Box Warnings**: - Toxic deaths related to abnormal liver function. - Severe neutropenia (ANC < 500 cells/mm3). - Severe hypersensitivity reactions requiring dexamethasone premedication. - **Dose Modifications**: Discontinue or reduce dose by 25% if patient develops Grade 4 neutropenia lasting > 7 days or Grade 3 peripheral neuropathy. ### 2. Cisplatin - **Indication**: Standard platinum backbone for combination chemotherapy in lung, bladder, ovarian, and testicular cancers. - **Approved Project Range**: 40 mg to 150 mg (typically 50 to 100 mg/m2). - **Major Toxicities**: Cumulative nephrotoxicity, ototoxicity, myelosuppression, severe nausea and vomiting. - **Contraindications**: Pre-existing renal impairment (serum creatinine > 1.5 mg/dL or CrCl < 50 mL/min). ### 4.
